explanation: Zero at every D1 and D2 step, and zero at GO whenever the previous trial was rewarded; it fires only at GO after an unrewarded trial, and it grows with the losing streak: about 3-7 after a single loss (often 0 after one loss that follows a long rewarded run) and 9-10 after two or more losses in a row. It is strongest late in the episode (trials 70-99), while unrewarded GOs before about trial 50 usually reach only 0-4.
